NVDA.supply_chain_summary: NVIDIA sits at the critical intersection of AI compute infrastructure, designing cutting-edge GPUs and accelerators that are exclusively manufactured by TSMC using advanced nodes, with HBM memory sourced from SK Hynix and Micron as key cost inputs. On the demand side, NVIDIA is heavily dependent on hyperscalers (Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, Google) who collectively account for an estimated 40-50% of data center segment revenues, making it both a supplier to and strategic partner of the world's largest cloud platforms.

upstream.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.

upstream.name: Qualcomm Inc.
upstream.relationship: Supplier of 5G modem chips (transitioning to in-house, but still material supplier)

upstream.name: Broadcom Inc.
upstream.relationship: Supplier of Wi-Fi/Bluetooth combo chips and custom RF components for iPhone

AAPL.supply_chain_summary: Apple sits at the apex of a highly complex global supply chain, acting as a world-class product integrator that sources advanced semiconductors, displays, and components from specialized suppliers—most critically TSMC for its proprietary Apple Silicon chips—while distributing finished products through carriers, retailers, and its own direct channels worldwide. Its downstream relationships are increasingly defined not just by hardware sales but by a growing services ecosystem (App Store, licensing, advertising), making platform partners like Google and major carriers as important to revenue as end consumers.

upstream.relationship: Sole supplier of EUV lithography equipment critical for advanced nodes (3nm, 5nm, 7nm)

upstream.name: Applied Materials
upstream.relationship: Major supplier of wafer fabrication equipment including CVD, PVD, and etch systems

upstream.name: Lam Research
upstream.relationship: Key supplier of deposition and etch equipment used across multiple process nodes

TSM.supply_chain_summary: TSMC sits at the apex of the global semiconductor supply chain as the world's dominant pure-play foundry, translating chip designs from fabless customers into physical silicon using cutting-edge process nodes. Its upstream dependencies are heavily concentrated in highly specialized capital equipment suppliers—most critically ASML for EUV lithography—while its downstream base spans the most valuable fabless chipmakers across AI, mobile, and data center end markets, making TSMC an irreplaceable chokepoint in global technology infrastructure.

MU.supply_chain_summary: Micron Technology sits at the heart of the global memory supply chain, depending heavily on a concentrated set of semiconductor equipment manufacturers (ASML, AMAT, LRCX) for the capital-intensive tools required to produce DRAM and NAND at leading-edge nodes. On the demand side, Micron is increasingly exposed to AI infrastructure tailwinds through HBM sales to NVIDIA and cloud hyperscalers, while also serving broad end markets including mobile, PC, and automotive through OEM and fabless chip customers.

IREN.supply_chain_summary: IREN Limited sits at the intersection of energy-intensive Bitcoin mining and AI-driven data center infrastructure, making it critically dependent on GPU/ASIC hardware suppliers like NVIDIA and Bitmain, as well as low-cost, reliable electricity supply. Its revenue is predominantly driven by Bitcoin price and mining economics, with a growing exposure to high-performance AI compute hosting as it diversifies its data center capacity toward enterprise cloud and HPC customers.

OKLO.supply_chain_summary: Oklo occupies an early-stage but strategically critical position as a vertically integrated advanced fission developer, depending heavily on a narrow set of specialized upstream suppliers for HALEU fuel, nuclear-grade components, and construction services that have very limited global alternatives. On the downstream side, Oklo is targeting high-value, long-duration power purchase agreements primarily with hyperscale data center operators and defense/industrial customers who require firm, carbon-free baseload power, though the company has yet to generate commercial revenue as it awaits NRC licensing approval for its Aurora Powerhouse design.
